v3.7.5 — Player Controls Stay Consistent After Audio Pipeline Switch

After v3.7.3/3.7.4's audio pipeline rebuild for 5.1 surround streams, the player's custom controls bar lost its auto-hide and the default Leanback transport overlay started bleeding through ("old format"). Both glitches are gone now — the rebuild reconnects to the same controls bar with its full auto-hide and styling intact.

• After the audio rebuild fires (5.1 surround on Fire TV Sticks), the polished player controls stay polished — same gold pause button, channel logo, EPG progress, action row
• Controls auto-hide normally after rebuild instead of getting stuck on screen
• Send Debug Log support email updated to oouchie@ooustream.com
